thread:
sre-bot: ALERT: high 5xx spike and connection resets observed for ingress euc2 (avg 5xx rate 18% over 2m). auto-page to #incidents and oncall.

sre-bot: metrics: envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_5xx{region="euc2"} +295% in last 2m.

maria: saw this too, customer error reports coming in for EU customers. Looks like Envoy upstream resets (RST_STREAM) mixed with ALB target health flaps.

aj: oncall here. I'm pulling ELB/ALB logs + kube events now. Can someone run a quick curl against the ingress in euc2?

zach: running: `curl -sv https://webapp.euc2.redwood.internal/health -o /dev/null` -> TLS handshake ok, then `HTTP/2 503` and `connection reset by peer` intermittently.

julia: checking aws console, ALB target-health shows targets healthy but `unused` counts increasing, and target deregistration attempts in the last 3m. Could be control-plane hiccup or network path.

maria: I'm seeing a pattern: requests routed to eu-central-2b are the majority of failures. Route53 latency-based routing has been weighting that AZ more due to lower latency historically.

aj: grabbing kube events for ingress-controller pods in euc2 cluster:

```
$ kubectl -n ingress get pods -o wide
ingress-nginx-0   CrashLoopBackOff  2/3  9m  10.0.2.45  eu-central-2bingress-nginx-1   Running          3/3  45m 10.0.3.12  eu-central-2a
```

aj: logs from nginx/Envoy show repeated `upstream connection reset by peer` and lots of 5xx generated by the ingress.

zach: AWS NLB in front of the euc2 nodes shows abnormal TCP reset counts. Could be noisy NIC or host-level networking issue in that AZ. Customer-impact is partial (subset of EU customers).

maria: tagging priority P1 (partial region outage). Notifying CS for customer comms. @ops-oncall please start incident bridge.

ops-oncall: bridge established: https://meet.redwood/incident/1789012345 (join_link). Joining now.

julia: quick mitigation suggestion: update Route53 policy to shift weight away from eu-central-2b to eu-central-2a/2c for latency/weighted policy. Also consider removing NLB nodes in 2b from target group to force failover.

aj: agreed. Before doing NLB changes, I want to confirm we have capacity in other AZs. Current pod autoscaler shows ~25% headroom in 2a/2c.

maria: I'm going to create a temporary traffic policy change. Making the weighted DNS change now to bias away from eu-central-2b by 70%.

sre-bot: NOTE: DNS TTL for webapp is 60s, changes will propagate quickly.

aj: executed `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id ZXYZ --change-batch file://shift-weight.json` (applied).

zach: observing immediate drop in 5xx rate within 45s. euc2 failures now mostly for 2b only, overall customer errors down ~60%.

maria: good. Next step: cordon and drain affected nodes in 2b to force healthy pods to reschedule in other AZs. I'll do a rolling drain with prepull images on 2a/2c.

aj: also opening ticket with cloud provider for suspected NIC flapping in AZ 2b. I've attached ELB/NLB flow logs and TCP reset counts.

julia: for root cause, let's capture envoy metrics and tcpdump from a problematic node before draining completes. I'll run `sudo tcpdump -n -i eth0 tcp port 443 -w /tmp/reset-cap.pcap` and upload.

sre-bot: incident timeline updated: mitigation (dns shift) applied 1789012408, partial recovery observed 1789012460.

zach: ops provider responded: they see degraded network fabric in eu-central-2b causing intermittent packet drops. They're doing host-level remediation. ETA initial patch 25m.

maria: handoff plan: aj will stay on primary, zach will monitor bridge and customer comms, I need to hand off in 30m to morning oncall (ops-oncall) due to schedule.

aj: I will take primary for the next hour. ops-oncall please confirm you can take full handoff at T+30.

ops-oncall: confirmed, I'll take the handoff at 1789012525 and continue until provider confirms stable. I'll keep customers updated via CS.

julia: uploading pcap and envoy logs to incident S3: s3://redwood-incidents/1789012345/ (logs.tar.gz). Link posted in bridge.

maria: customer impact summary for CS: "Partial regional degradation in eu-central-2b causing intermittent 5xx for EU customers. Mitigation: traffic shifted away from affected AZ; autoscaling and node drains in progress; cloud provider is remediating NIC/network fabric in eu-central-2b. Estimated full recovery TBD but partial routing fix applied."

aj: next actions: 1) monitor 5xx and reset metrics for 30m, 2) confirm nodes in 2b come back healthy or replaced, 3) revert DNS weight when provider confirms stable.

zach: creating post-incident ticket with details and runbook gaps (we should automate weighted failover in this scenario).

ops-oncall: taking over. I'll post status updates every 15m on this thread. Joining bridge.

sre-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated_partial, impacted_region=euc2, mitigation=route53_weight_shift+node_drain, incident_owner=ops-oncall.

maria: thanks team, handing off now. :raised_hands:

aj: thanks, taking over until ops-oncall confirms closure.

ops-oncall: noted. next update at 1789012620.
